defects.label: Roof damage
defects.look_for: missing or curling shingles, damaged flashing, sagging roof lines

defects.label: Water intrusion
defects.look_for: water stains, active leaks, moisture damage on walls or ceilings

defects.label: Foundation or structural cracks
defects.look_for: cracks in foundation, walls, or structural members

defects.label: Electrical hazard
defects.look_for: exposed wiring, scorched outlets, open panel, missing covers

defects.label: Plumbing problem
defects.look_for: leaking or corroded pipes, fixture leaks, water heater issues

defects.label: Window or door damage
defects.look_for: rotted frames, broken glass or seals, doors that do not close

defects.label: Pest or wood damage
defects.look_for: termite tubes, carpenter ant damage, rodent evidence

defects.label: Cannot determine
defects.look_for: the photo does not show enough to decide
